_comment: Checked-in fixture for the in-app-calling render scenario (#1657/#1659). Enables the PBX, the SIP edge and the TURN relay together, which is the only configuration in which SIP_REGISTRAR_SECRET / TURN_HOST / TURN_SECRET / SIP_TLS_CA_FILE are rendered and the trust-anchor bind mount appears in the app compose file. The base scenario has none of them enabled, so check-required-env.py can assert the opposite outcome from the same templates — the render guard is falsifiable in both directions. Values are dummy placeholders that only need to be non-empty and long enough; never real credentials.
